

Where does Stemming, Lemmatization, Stop words etc fit in an NLP project

When we have data set, firstly we would do Text preprocessing. 

Step 1 - DataSet

Step 2
In Text preprocessing Part 1 (Cleaning process):
1. Tokenization 
2. Lowering the Case of words - this is to make same word in 2 diff cases as same. eg. The and the are same
3. Regular Expression - can be removing special character etc.

Step 3
Text preprocessing Part 2 (Cleaning text):
1. Stemming
2. Lemmatization
3. Stop words

Step 4
Coverting text to Vectors (numerical represenation of certain text/data):
1. One Hot encoded ( now not mostly used )
2. Bag of Words (BOW) - Imp
3. TF - IDF
4. Word2Vec
5. AvgWord2Vec
